notes: Live boutique Shopify storefront, direct fetch worked throughout (no blocking). Full nav mapped via mega-menu (109 links). IMPORTANT platform quirk: this theme uses Klevu category-merchandising (CATNAV) to hydrate several collection grids client-side; for Pendant Lights, Wall Lights, Table & Floor Lamps, Outdoor Lighting and Candlelight the static HTML/native Shopify /products.json report a stale/placeholder count (0 for the four lighting collections, 10 for Candlelight) while the Klevu-hydrated live page (verified via rendered fetch, cross-checked by enumerating every listed product title) reports the true counts used here (6/9/6/3/19). For all other rows the native Shopify products.json count matched the rendered 'N products' header exactly (Mirrors 23, Bathroom Mirrors 14, Lampshades 18, Decorative Accessories 27, Tableware 27, Glassware 5), so both sources agree. Rule 0 gain: included Bathroom Mirrors (14, room-based lighting/mirror branch under the site's separate 'Bathroom' menu) and Outdoor Lighting (3, under the 'Garden' menu) which older room-word rules would have skipped; also kept Lampshades and Candlelight (verified unscented -- beeswax candles + candle holders/snuffers/a lantern, no diffusers/room sprays/scented wording) since product type, not the accessory-menu placement, governs scope. Rule 0.6 overlap: 'Mirrors' (type tree, 23) and 'Bathroom Mirrors' (room tree, 14) are two genuine nav branches from different menus; Bathroom Mirrors is a full product-ID subset of Mirrors -- both emitted per Rule 0.6, overlap documented here. Excluded: Handmade Ceramics (24) -- a material facet re-cut whose product titles are 100% duplicated across Tableware (plates/mugs), Candlelight (candle holders) and terracotta-pot decor, not a distinct product type. Bathroom Accessories (28) and Bathroom Fittings -- predominantly toilet-brush holders, shower caddies, soap pumps, towel rails, bath mats, shower curtain (bathroom hardware/textiles), only 1 borderline decorative item (a soap dish), so the node was dropped whole per the mixed-rollup rule. Hooks & Rails (9) -- lives under the site's own 'Hardware' department (sibling of Knobs & Handles, Latches, Door Handles) and is dominated by Wilbur towel rails (bathroom fittings); dropped as functional hardware. Also excluded: all Garden (furniture/seating/tables/cushions/potting) except Outdoor Lighting; all Furniture; Hardware (knobs, latches, door handles, front door furniture); Rugs, Cushions & Blankets, Table Linen, Bedlinen & Textiles (textiles); Kitchen Storage, Dining Furniture, Bedroom Furniture (storage/furniture); Last Chance and Gently Imperfect sections (clearance/outlet, incl. their own Lighting/Accessories/Furniture/Hardware sub-nodes); every 'All' roll-up node (all-lighting, all-accessories, all-bathroom, all-garden, all-furniture, all-hardware) as non-category superset navigation, and all-lighting additionally showed an internally inconsistent count (native json 18 vs rendered 42) reinforcing it is not a reliable standalone row.
